meta.title: 생략·공동구문
meta.note: 정답·해설 p.35의 Unit 17 Q01~Q04 대표 원문과 생략·병렬 설명을 직접 대조해 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.sentence: A certain amount of self-examination is useful, but that should be directed toward what to do in a given situation and not at only blaming yourself severely.
items.prompt: and not 앞에서 반복을 피하기 위해 생략된 어구를 고르세요.
items.explanation: 앞의 should be directed가 and 뒤에도 공통으로 적용되어 반복되는 should be directed가 생략된 구조입니다.
items.memory: and 뒤가 불완전하면 앞의 반복 성분을 복원

items.sentence: Majoring in philosophy, I had a chance to explore different kinds of philosophical theories and to see what thinkers (in different periods) had to say about them.
items.prompt: a chance 뒤에서 and로 병렬 연결된 두 to부정사구를 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: to explore different kinds of philosophical theories
to see what thinkers (in different periods) had to say about them
items.explanation: to explore ...와 to see ...가 병렬로 연결되어 a chance를 수식합니다. 병렬된 두 번째 to는 문맥에 따라 생략될 수도 있습니다.

items.sentence: Majoring in philosophy, I had a chance to explore different kinds of philosophical theories and to see what thinkers (in different periods) had to say about them.
items.prompt: 문장 끝 them이 가리키는 대상을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 해설의 문맥처럼 them은 앞에서 탐구한 different kinds of philosophical theories를 가리킵니다.

items.sentence: Many companies are trying to reduce as many plastics as possible these days. Plastic is not always easily or economically recyclable, and once manufactured, plastic may last virtually indefinitely.
items.prompt: once manufactured를 완전한 절로 복원할 때 생략된 주어+be동사를 고르세요.
items.explanation: 부사절과 주절의 주어가 같을 때 접속사 once 뒤의 주어+be동사가 생략될 수 있습니다. 여기서는 once it (= plastic) is manufactured입니다.

items.sentence: Performance is something you do that brings about an observable change in the external world; learning, on the other hand, is a change within the learner, although often a result of interaction with the external world.
items.prompt: although often a result ...에서 생략된 주어+be동사를 고르세요.
items.explanation: although 이하의 의미상 주어는 learning이며, 주절과 주어가 같아 it (= learning) is가 생략된 구조로 설명됩니다.
